FROM products p
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.base_price ASC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.base_price DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.review_count DESC, p.average_rating DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p

SELECT p.id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.name, p.description, p.base_price, p.stock_quantity, p.product_type, p.preparation_days, p.average_rating, p.review_count FROM products p INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT pi.id, pi.product_id, pi.image_url, pi.sort_order FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = #{productId} AND pi.id = #{imageId}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.product_type AS productType, p.preparation_days AS preparationDays, p.base_price AS basePrice, p.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, p.status FROM products p WHERE p.id = #{productId}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.product_type AS productType, p.preparation_days AS preparationDays, p.base_price AS basePrice, p.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, p.status FROM products p WHERE p.id = #{productId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT pog.id AS group_id, pog.name AS group_name, pog.required, pog.selection_type, po.id AS option_id, po.name AS option_name, po.additional_price FROM products p INNER JOIN product_option_groups pog ON pog.product_id = p.id AND pog.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN product_options po ON po.option_group_id = pog.id AND po.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY pog.sort_order ASC, pog.id ASC, po.sort_order ASC, po.id ASC

SELECT pog.id AS groupId, pog.name AS groupName, pog.required, pog.selection_type AS selectionType, pog.status AS groupStatus, pog.sort_order AS groupSortOrder, po.id AS optionId, po.name AS optionName, po.additional_price AS additionalPrice, po.status AS optionStatus, po.sort_order AS optionSortOrder FROM product_option_groups pog LEFT JOIN product_options po ON po.option_group_id = pog.id WHERE pog.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY pog.sort_order ASC, pog.id ASC, po.sort_order ASC, po.id ASC

SELECT pog.id AS groupId, pog.name AS groupName, pog.required, pog.selection_type AS selectionType, pog.status AS groupStatus, pog.sort_order AS groupSortOrder, po.id AS optionId, po.name AS optionName, po.additional_price AS additionalPrice, po.status AS optionStatus, po.sort_order AS optionSortOrder FROM product_option_groups pog LEFT JOIN product_options po ON po.option_group_id = pog.id WHERE pog.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY pog.sort_order ASC, pog.id ASC, po.sort_order ASC, po.id ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT pog.id AS groupId, pog.name AS groupName, pog.required, pog.selection_type AS selectionType, pog.status AS groupStatus, pog.sort_order AS groupSortOrder, po.id AS optionId, po.name AS optionName, po.additional_price AS additionalPrice, po.status AS optionStatus, po.sort_order AS optionSortOrder FROM product_option_groups pog LEFT JOIN product_options po ON po.option_group_id = pog.id WHERE pog.product_id = #{productId} AND pog.id = #{optionGroupId} ORDER BY po.sort_order ASC, po.id ASC FOR UPDATE

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( category_id, name, description, base_price, stock_quantity, product_type, preparation_days, status ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{basePrice}, #{stockQuantity, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{productType}, #{preparationDays}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.category_id AS categoryId, p.name, p.description, p.base_price AS basePrice, p.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, p.stock_quantity AS originalStockQuantity, p.product_type AS productType, p.preparation_days AS preparationDays FROM products p WHERE p.id = #{productId}
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET category_id = #{product.categoryId}, name = #{product.name}, description = #{product.description, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, base_price = #{product.basePrice}, stock_quantity = #{product.stockQuantity, jdbcType=INTEGER}, product_type = #{product.productType}, preparation_days = #{product.preparationDays} WHERE id = #{product.id} AND stock_quantity <=> #{originalStockQuantity, jdbcType=INTEGER}
